description.value: You can pick out the wrongness in a haunted comm-line or a corrupted broadcast the way others pick out a familiar voice. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks about occult phenomena that manifest through electronics or old-world signal equipment.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Recall Knowledge bonus is scoped to 'occult phenomena that manifest through electronics or old-world signal equipment' -- the same topic-has-no-roll-option problem as Faction Ledger.
